requirements: Users belong to tenants (memberships). Every table with a tenant_id column (memberships, docs and files, and any table added later) is tenant-scoped the same way: members of a tenant see, add and change its rows, and a row never moves into a tenant the user does not belong to. Nobody deletes. A file's size is never negative. The tenants table itself is not exposed to users.
expected_properties: Docs are only seen, added and changed by members of their tenant.
Files are only seen, added and changed by members of their tenant.
Leaving a tenant never grants access.
Whatever is written to docs can be read back.
Whatever is written to files can be read back.
The application role may only select/insert/update docs and files and select memberships; nothing on tenants.
A member reads the docs of their tenants.
A member reads the files of their tenants.
A member adds a file of non-negative size to their tenant.
